children: The system will monitor PM2.5 and PM10 levels, with an outdoor display board providing real-time access to air quality readings at the facility

SFK Industries has facilitated the installation of an Ambient Air Quality Monitoring System at Honda Motorcycle and Scooter India Pvt. Ltd.'s Gurugram facility. The system will measure and record particulate matter levels, including PM2.5 and PM10, at pre-set intervals, while an outdoor display board will make the readings accessible to people at the premises.

The installation includes the AAQMS-M01 monitoring unit, manufactured by Engineering & Environmental Solutions Pvt. Ltd. It uses light-scattering technology to measure both particulate matter categories simultaneously.
The system has a PM2.5 measurement range of 0–500 µg/m³ and a PM10 range of 0–1,000 µg/m³, with a resolution of 1 µg/m³ and an accuracy of ±5 per cent of full scale.

The monitoring unit features a 3.5-inch touch display and operates in Survey and Recording modes. In Recording mode, readings are stored with location identification, date and time details. Users can configure recording intervals of five, 15 or 30 minutes.

The collected data can be accessed through Windows-based software and exported to Microsoft Excel. The equipment also supports data transfer through RS232 and USB ports, alongside General Packet Radio Service (GPRS) connectivity to a cloud server.

An outdoor P10 multi-colour display board has also been installed to show air quality readings at the facility. The board can accommodate at least eight lines of information and is designed to operate in ambient temperatures of up to 55 degrees Celsius.
The installation gives Honda's Gurugram facility the capability to measure and record PM2.5 and PM10 levels, providing a clearer picture of air quality around its premises.
SFK Industries said it facilitated the installation based on the facility's monitoring requirements.
